get.description: Returns arrivals for the supplied TIPLOC code within a defined time window.

parameters.name: tiploc
parameters.description: The TIPLOC code of the location for which the request is being made.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Start time of the departure board.

parameters.name: numRows
parameters.description: The number of services to return in the resulting station board, between 0 and 150 exclusive.

parameters.name: timeWindow
parameters.description: How far into the future in minutes, relative to the time, to return services for, between 0 and 1440.

parameters.name: filterCRS
parameters.description: The CRS code of either an origin or destination location to filter in. Optional.

parameters.name: filterType
parameters.description: The type of filter to apply. Filters services to include only those originating or terminating at the filterTiploc location.

parameters.name: filterTOC
parameters.description: The TOC code to apply to the filter. Filters services to include only those belonging to the specified TOC. Optional.

parameters.name: services
parameters.description: P for train Services, B for bus services, and S for ship services. Defaults to 'P'. Optional.

parameters.name: getNonPassengerServices
parameters.description: Flag which indicates whether to get non-passenger services.

get.description: Returns all public departures for the supplied CRS code within a defined time window, including service details.

parameters.name: crs
parameters.description: The CRS code of the location for which the request is being made.  Usage: 3 characters, alphabetic, UPPERCASE

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Start time of the departure board.

parameters.name: numRows
parameters.description: The number of services to return in the resulting station board.  Usage: between 0 and 150 exclusive

parameters.name: timeWindow
parameters.description: How far into the future in minutes, relative to the time, to return services for. Optional.  Usage: between 0 and 1440

parameters.name: filterCRS
parameters.description: The CRS code of either an origin or destination location to filter in. Optional.  Usage: 3 characters, alphabetic, UPPERCASE

parameters.name: filterType
parameters.description: The type of filter to apply. Filters services to include only those originating or terminating at the filterTiploc location.

parameters.name: filterTOC
parameters.description: The TOC code to apply to the filter. Filters services to include only those belonging to the specified TOC. Optional

parameters.name: services
parameters.description: P for train Services, B for bus services, S for ship services. Defaults to 'P'. Optional

parameters.name: getNonPassengerServices
parameters.description: Flag which indicates whether to get non-passenger services.Defaults to 'false'. Optional
